title: Twenty-four flyers
logline: The Crab Derby, private, in the months he isn't in the pages: the wall with twenty-four flyers and nobody pinning. The newest is in the girl's hand. Whoever lettered it, the page doesn't show.

panels.composition: The shingle wall with twenty-four crab flyers in a row, the newest crisp in an eleven-year-old's careful hand, nobody at the wall, a February morning, the dock beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle wall with a long row of twenty-four weathered crab flyers ending in a crisp new one in a child's careful hand, nobody present, a dock beyond in February light, no words
image.notes: 1998–2021 = 24. Absent period: no man on the page.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
